test.latency_scope: graph + model + output, with prefetched transfer; input wait and explanations reported separately

calibration.assumption: exchangeability of benign calibration and deployment scores; drift can invalidate coverage

split_plan.cut_method: campaign-forward purged blocks from per-block label counts; no features or model scores
split_plan.selection_rule: no candidate met the coverage floor; among candidates purging <= 0.12 of rows, maximised the number of classes present in every split, then their minimum coverage ratio, then block length
split_plan.state_isolation: graph and endpoint state reset at every segment; no context crosses a split boundary
split_plan.note: Each family trains on earlier activity than it is tested on; different families interleave in time, so this is not a single global-forward deployment claim. Use --split_scope global for that protocol.

timing_profile.source: UQ NetFlow v3 release: flows exported in intervals of at most two minutes (nProbe active timeout 120 s, idle timeout 60 s, scan <= 1 s)

availability_guarantee: conditional on the supplied exporter/transport/collector contract
